scope: research only; no production change or state confirmation

geometry.qualification: tuned on three images; not held-out. Geometry-only detection, not full scene classification. The original Swift implementation has additional split/fallback logic not tested end-to-end.

appearance.method: Python approximate feature extraction; rounded query values ranked via connector against full existing feature dictionary. Non-shiny templates, no gender or full regulation filtering.

types.qualification: Adjusted coordinates visually fitted; errors shifted rather than eliminated; prior Swift 3x3 search not tested end-to-end. No hard type filter recommended.

limitations: Two battles, four preview images; three images of one battle share the same six identities; no statistical accuracy claim.
Reference feature source overlap with test battle not independently excluded; dictionary covers selected entries only and is not verified M-C legality master.
Approximate Python port not proven numerically equivalent to Swift. Type-assisted result assumes true types supplied manually, not automatic end-to-end recognition.
No pixel-level ground truth or calibrated rejection threshold, no complete automatic 6-species classification.
Only code and aggregate records published; no raw screenshots or player/team identifiers.
